title: Topwater machine manifest
description: manifest.json of a .topwater file (and of a snapshot, which is a .topwater without history): one machine, its files and its session. File contents are in blobs/<sha256>. Readers also enforce the limits in spec/topwater-file/README.md, which a schema cannot express.

version.description: 1, 2 when a file entry is a symbolic link or has a link, 3 when there are mounts. A writer uses the lowest it can, so older readers load it. A reader refuses a newer version than it knows.

files.description: Every file, directory and link, each parent before its children. At most MaxExtractEntries entries; the sizes add up to at most MaxFileSystemBytes.

variables.description: Sorted by name; each name once.

body.description: As written after `name()`; `name() body` must parse as exactly one function definition.

jobs.description: Finished background jobs: [pid, exit code], each pid once.

clock.description: The virtual clock, for a shell made with a start time.

random.description: The seeded random generator's state (an unsigned 64-bit number), for a shell made with a seed.

mounts.description: Version 3: sources mounted into the machine (docs/mounts.md): the definition and the pending changes, never the source's files, which files leaves out. Left out when none. A reader keeps these changes apart until the host accepts them, and takes each mount's mode from the host, never from here.

path.description: The mount point; never /, and no two mounts nest.

mode.description: The mode when saved; informational: a loading shell uses the mode its host mounted with.

type.description: The source's kind (local-folder, memory, ...); with id, what a loading shell matches a source by.

id.description: The host's name for this source; never a secret.

changes.description: The pending changes, in the order they apply.

path.description: Within the source: / is the mount point.

version.description: The version the entry had when read; absent: it must not exist yet.

time.description: ISO 8601. Writers use UTC with seven fraction digits: 2026-11-25T09:00:00.0000000Z. No zone means UTC.

path.description: Absolute and normal: no empty, . or .. segment, no trailing slash (readers check the segments).

mode.description: Octal permission bits, written as four digits.

size.description: A file's length in bytes (left out when 0).

binary.description: The content is bytes, not UTF-8 text.

reportedSize.description: The size ls and stat show, when it differs from the content (a sparse or placeholder file).

blob.description: SHA-256 of the content, which is blobs/<blob>. Required for a file with size > 0 and no link.

target.description: Version 2: a symbolic link's target, as written (relative or absolute).

link.description: Version 2: another name of a file or symbolic link: the path of its first name, which comes earlier in files. Never a directory.

next.description: An indexed array's next append index; at least the highest index + 1.

items.description: [key, value] pairs; an indexed array's keys are canonical non-negative integers.
